simple.meaning: כָּסָה (kâçâh) appears 153 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with kingship. The surrounding account also brings the name into blood crying from the ground.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 11 more, beginning at Genesis 7:19. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, blood, kingship, mountain.

simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows כָּסָה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

A prudent man keeps his knowledge,
He who covers an offense promotes love;
